verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for an infrastructure framework like Crossplane, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an llms.txt file or any documentation written for agents. The homepage claims that AI agents can act on Crossplane's declarative APIs, but that is about runtime APIs, not agent-readable docs, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
